messages:
mira: Need a compact battlecard and a routing play for next Wed's webinar. Focus: concise competitive hooks vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Also want follow-up email variants to A/B test. Drop microcopy and routing rules here by EOD? :spiral_calendar:
aj: Short hooks from me: 1) Cloud A: predictable latency + cost controls. 2) LLM APIs: unified runtime + observability. 3) Infra vendors: less ops, faster ship. Keep each under 12 words.
leah: For customer-facing copy, propose these three single-line claims to test in webinar CTAs and slide headers:
- Cloud claim: "Consistent latency and predictable cost across deployments."
- API claim: "One API, every runtime — fast onboarding, uniform ops."
- Infra claim: "Skip rolling-your-own infra: built-in batching, caching, fallbacks."
Caroline: Nice. I'll make 3 short follow-up email bodies (50-70 words) that map to those claims with a single CTA (book a quick demo). Want me to paste drafts here?
mira: Yes please. Also we need routing rules for leads from the webinar vs on-demand views. Ops prefers deterministic rules they can code into the CRM. Sam, can you propose a minimal rule set?
sam: Minimal routing pseudo (will translate to Outreach/HubSpot): ```
# priority routing
if lead.event == 'webinar_live' and lead.account_tier == 'enterprise':
  assign -> assigned_AE
elif lead.event in ['webinar_live','webinar_od'] and lead.role in ['platform','ml_engineer']:
  assign -> Platform_Solutions_SE
elif lead.engagement_score >= 75 and lead.trial_tokens > 500000:
  assign -> Sales_Exec
else:
  assign -> Marketing_Nurture
```
aj: Add a safety net: if lead.recent_api_calls > 10000 and trial_active == true -> escalate to AE regardless of tier. That catches high-commit prospects.
sam: Good call, adding now.
leah: Draft email bodies (short):
A (latency+cost): "Thanks for joining — If unpredictability in latency and billing is slowing you down, we can help. Redwood gives predictable tail latency and token-level cost visibility so you can hit SLAs without guesswork. Interested in a 15-min walkthrough?"
B (runtime+observability): "Great to see you — Want the same API for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments? Redwood lets teams ship with one runtime and full observability into token-level cost and latency. Book a quick demo."
C (ops+infra): "Appreciate you tuning in — Building and operating inference infra is costly. Redwood provides production-ready batching, KV caching, and graceful fallbacks so your engineers ship features faster. Ready to evaluate?"
caroline: These are clean. I'll trim to 1-2 sentence version for webinar follow-up SMS/LinkedIn outreach. Also need a one-paragraph benchmark line for the slide and follow-up that Eng can verify (no vague words). @aj or @leo can Eng confirm a succinct stat we can publish?
aj: I'll ping runtime to validate. Likely: "Our internal microbenchmarks show ~2x reduction in P95 for long-chat workloads vs default managed endpoints under mixed-concurrency load." I'll confirm exact test name and numbers.
ops-bot: Routing rules doc updated: https://drive.redwood/marketing/inbound-routing/v4 (ops notified) :white_check_mark:
mira: OK owners: leah (email variants + trimmed outreach), caroline (battlecard one-pager + slides), sam (finalize CRM routing + implement), aj (bench numbers from Eng). Deadline: tomorrow 11am PT. Thanks all — keep replies short here so we can copy into the playbook. :rocket:
